questions: How many SQUIDs did you fabricate and measure, and in how many did you see a half-period intercept, a finite η′ at B = 0, and the second harmonic? Your p. 4 lists 0°, 40°, 42°, 44° and 45° devices, but the counts behind each claim are not in the v1 PDF.
Why were the other devices set aside for the phase measurement, and does any device show only integer intercepts at every in-plane field?

Which in-plane fields, perpendicular field ranges, bias currents and temperatures did you measure beyond those shown, and were the in-plane sweeps of Extended Data Fig. 2 repeated in another cooldown?
What does the second-best phase dataset look like? SI 14 is cited for another device but is not part of the v1 PDF.

What is the uncertainty on each intercept in Fig. 3 and Extended Data Fig. 2? The fit in Fig. 3a spans 41 to 59 µA and extrapolates to I = 0 over more than twice that span, and the slopes in Fig. 3a and 3b read about 0.05 and 0.07 period per µA to me; why would A Lgeo change between 0 and 10 µT in-plane field, and how did you make sure each star tracks the same minimum?

Did you warm above Tc and cool in zero field between in-plane settings, and does the intercept repeat after that? The half-integer values spread from about 0.75π to 0.95π and differ between sweep directions at 0 µT (Extended Data Fig. 2), and the period is about seven times smaller than Φ0/Ageo (p. 6), which suggests flux in the surrounding flakes couples to the loop.

Where is the true zero of flux in Fig. 4? Is+(+B) and |Is−(−B)| in Fig. 4a look like copies shifted along B; what residual field do you measure inside the cryoperm shield, what offset would bring η′(0) to zero, and how does the 0° control's η′(B) compare?
Did you simulate Is(Φ) for a purely first-harmonic CPR with your 3:1 arm asymmetry and β ∼ 1, and compare its FFT with Fig. 4d? How was the background in Fig. 4d chosen and subtracted?
